تستقلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقِلُّوا (tastaqillū) /tas.ta.qil.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقَلَّ (istaqalla)
# تُسْتَقَلُّوا (tustaqallū) /tus.ta.qal.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقَلَّ (istaqalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
